{{Top|leg}}
'''Slalliin''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Slalliin preferred finesse over brute force, and disliked those who employed [[Riot gun/Legends|riot gun]]s.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
